children: Srirup sircar moves to a wider india business mandate after more than 11 years across cipla’s hr function

Cipla has appointed Srirup Sircar as Senior Director and HR Head - Talent Acquisition, Employee Relations and HR Operations for its One India Business. Sircar takes on the expanded role in October 2026 after leading HR for the company’s Respiratory Cluster for more than five years.

Sircar will oversee talent acquisition, employee relations and HR operations as part of his new mandate. The move expands his responsibilities from a business-cluster role to a broader India Business HR portfolio.

He has spent more than 11 years at Cipla, working across HR leadership and business partnering roles. His experience at the pharmaceutical company includes strategic people initiatives, HR business partnering and leadership responsibilities for the Respiratory Cluster.
Sircar joined Cipla in January 2015 as Associate Director HR for the India Business, a position he held until June 2020.

He was appointed Director, Human Resources for the Respiratory Cluster in July 2020 and moved to Senior Director and HR Head for the cluster in January 2023. He held the latter position until September 2026.

During his tenure with the Respiratory Cluster, Sircar was responsible for the people agenda supporting the business. His latest appointment brings talent acquisition, employee relations and HR operations under his broader remit.
Before joining Cipla, Sircar spent more than 12 years at Abbott, where he worked as Chief Manager HR from December 2002 to January 2015.

His responsibilities at Abbott covered sales, training and HR within the pharmaceutical sector. He also worked as an HR Business Partner for assigned business units and was involved in strategic people initiatives.
His profile states that he handled a team of about 1,300 field employees across eight divisions during his Abbott tenure.

Sircar has more than two decades of experience in human resources, primarily across the pharmaceutical sector. His career spans HR business partnering, talent acquisition, employee relations, training and people management.
He holds a PGDHR in Human Resources from the Institute of Management Technology, Ghaziabad, and a Bachelor of Science in Econometrics and Quantitative Economics from Calcutta University, Kolkata.
The appointment moves Sircar from leading HR for a specific business cluster to a wider mandate covering key HR functions across Cipla’s One India Business.
